Subject: RE: [opensuse] Apache and SSL

Can anyone provide some informations/links on how the apache server
can be configured with SSL on openSuSE 10.3?
-- 



vi /etc/sysconfig/apache2

make sure on APACHE_SERVER_FLAGS you have SSL like:
APACHE_SERVER_FLAGS="SSL"

And that APACHE_MODULES has ssl listed:
APACHE_MODULES="authz_host actions ... ssl ..."

# rcapache2 restart

Woala, you have SSL setup.

--
Nick Zeljkovic
